name: How long does roof flashing repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does roof flashing repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of roof flashing repair depends on the scope and complexity of the job. A minor repair, such as resealing a small section or replacing a single piece of flashing around a vent, might be completed within a few hours. More extensive repairs, involving multiple areas, custom-fabricated flashing, or significant damage around a chimney or valley, could take a full day or even longer. Factors like weather conditions and roof accessibility also play a role. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after assessing the specific repair needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor fixes to a full day or more for extensive damage, depending on complexity and accessibility.
